      "body": "Three failed login attempts detected from Eastern Europe between 2024-05-10 and 2024-05-15 preceded the successful access. No further activity after session termination.",

    }

  "created": "2024-05-12T10:05:00.000+08:00",

  "status": "Open",

workspace_files.shared_account_issue.json:
{
  "assignee": "auditor.readonly",
  "attachments": [],
  "comments": [
    {
      "author": "auditor.readonly",
      "body": "Recommend enforcing MFA reset for all Zenith Logistics accounts with portal access. Also suggest reviewing temporary worker access logs for Q2 2024.",
      "created": "2024-05-18T14:05:00.000+08:00"
    },
    {
      "author": "warehouse.lead",
      "body": "Temporary worker has been removed from the schedule and their access revoked. Additional training on credential sharing planned for next week.",
      "created": "2024-05-19T08:45:00.000+08:00"
    }
  ],
  "created": "2024-05-14T02:20:00.000+08:00",
  "description": "Marcus Rivera disabled 2FA on his account to share login credentials with a temporary worker during the night shift on 2024-05-14. The temporary worker used the account to update inventory counts, and the 2FA setting was re-enabled after the shift ended.",
  "issue_key": "ZENITH-4502",
  "priority": "High",
  "reporter": "warehouse.lead",
  "status": "Open",
  "summary": "2FA bypass reported for warehouse supervisor account",
  "updated": "2024-05-18T14:05:00.000+08:00"
}
